title: 3898. Find the Degree of Each Vertex

examples.explanation: Vertex 0 is connected to vertices 1 and 2, so its degree is 2. Vertex 1 is connected to vertices 0 and 2, so its degree is 2. Vertex 2 is connected to vertices 0 and 1, so its degree is 2. Thus, the answer is [2, 2, 2].

Vertex 0 is connected to vertex 1, so its degree is 1. Vertex 1 is connected to vertex 0, so its degree is 1. Vertex 2 is not connected to any vertex, so its degree is 0. Thus, the answer is [1, 1, 0].
There is only one vertex and it has no edges connected to it. Thus, the answer is [0].
